grand_strategy.reading: Sudan is the Luttwak case of a state at war with its own instrument. The RSF was raised by the regime to guard it against its own army, and the generals who let it grow (Burhan took power together with Hemedti in October 2021) can neither win without destroying it nor accept a truce that leaves it standing. The Gulf and Egypt, which dealt with both generals before the war (the UAE promoted Hemedti's economic role), are now divided inside the Quad, so the army's strategy is a negotiation with its own sponsors: keep Cairo, Riyadh, Ankara and Doha, shut out Abu Dhabi, and avoid being sold a freeze of the lines by Washington. October 2026 finds it with momentum in Kordofan and on the wrong side of the US visa desk. Two signals that are not rows: the Russian naval base at Port Sudan, agreed in December 2020, has no source showing it ratified or built, so Moscow is a supplier and a reserve, not an anchor; and Burhan's postponed trip to the UN General Assembly in September, with his US visa reportedly withheld until he accepts a ceasefire, which shows that the state's own head is now a bargaining object for Washington. The paradoxes share one shape: each lever that wins ground (Islamist brigades, Iranian and Turkish drones, refusing the Quad) buys the army less standing with the people who will write the settlement.

stances.note: Each side seeks the other's end, so the ontology's mortal-enemy grade applies. Burhan rejects any truce that leaves the militia in place (the Quad text of Nov 2025 'the worst yet'), urged the UN in 2023 to declare the RSF a terrorist organisation and wrote in 2026 that pauses only let it regroup; the RSF built its own state (Government of Peace and Unity, announced 15 Apr 2025, seat Nyala) and Hemedti told his troops, as Reuters reported on 22 Sept 2026, that 'it's time for the rifles to speak'. The RSF's acceptance of a humanitarian truce (6 Nov 2025) was a tactical move, not a change of aim. Bond grievance: the RSF is the state's own creation (Janjaweed reorganised in 2013, an independent force by law in 2017), a betrayal wound, not a kin tie.

Symmetric pair. Bond grievance: the open wound is the war itself and the accusation of complicity in genocide.
